notes: No standalone production ResourceTable exists; React parity uses a test-local presentational harness.
The harness contains synthetic labels only and defines no product DTO fields or destructive actions.

geometry.selection: full-width row control inside semantic table cells

expectedTokenGeometry: Header and cells share aligned columns
Selected row uses border and surface treatment without color-only meaning

r10.keyboardTouch: row controls activate through native button keyboard and pointer behavior
r10.screenReader: caption, column headers, and aria-pressed row selection are exposed
r10.reducedMotion: selection does not depend on motion
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: synthetic visible status accompanies each row
r10.zoom: labels remain text in semantic cells
r10.darkLight: harness renders in zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: table remains in a bounded overflow container
